basic_info.description: Beautifully remodeled four bedroom/four and a half bath home on one of the best blocks in West Portal. Quality finishes and features throughout, views and prime location.  Three ensuite bedrooms on upper level, including primary with fireplace, bright open first floor plan with a top-of-the-line chef's kitchen featuring Thermador Professional appliances, custom cabinetry and center island. Lower level includes a guest bedroom and bath, and family room opening to fenced yard with patio & deck. Other amenities: spacious garage with EV charging, 3 gas fireplaces, custom hardwood floors, designer lighting & custom shades, central air conditioning, upgraded HVAC, electrical and plumbing. Enjoy excellent local schools, nearby shopping, popular restaurants, great transit and easy access to 280 and 101 freeways.
